# Parley v0.1.5

This follow-up beta hardens the v0.1.4 workspace transaction for inherited,
long-running tmux servers whose first reconciliation response can also arrive
empty.

## Fixed

- Recovery now queries the unique `Parley-Pending-<UUID>` window directly and
  retries with short, bounded delays before falling back to a full live pane
  inventory.
- If tmux still returns no identifiers, Parley removes that exact provisional
  target by name. Cleanup no longer depends on having captured an id, so a
  failed open cannot leak another invisible live window.
- A provisional window surviving an older crash derives its visible workspace
  name from its folder rather than exposing the internal UUID name.
- First-session bootstrap and later folder opening use the same transaction and
  cleanup behavior.

## Verification

- Native regression checks reproduce delayed output for the exact provisional
  target and complete loss of captured identifiers before verifying successful
  recovery or exact cleanup.
- The complete deterministic suite contains 139 native checks plus the
  packaging, security, public-history and VS Code companion checks.
- A clean Production reset was verified with v0.1.4, followed by a successful
  external `parley open` that created a fully classified workspace without a
  pending window. v0.1.5 adds the non-destructive inherited-server guard above.

## Install and upgrade

- Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
- `tmux` and at least one supported, installed and signed-in vendor CLI.
- Download `Parley-0.1.5-mac-arm64.dmg`, quit Parley, replace `Parley.app` in
  Applications, and reopen it.
- Existing tmux panes, workspace folders, layouts, context and collaboration
  history remain under `~/Library/Application Support/Parley Native`.
- This beta is ad-hoc signed and is **not notarized**. Use **System Settings →
  Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** only when the files came from this expected
  release. Never disable Gatekeeper globally.

Use `Parley-0.1.5-mac-arm64.SHA256SUMS` to verify every downloaded artifact.
